description: The one write on a mention: status "ignored" (not interesting) or "done" (handled), "open" to put it back; assign it to a workspace member (assigneeId, null to unassign); snooze it out of the feed until an ISO 8601 instant (snoozedUntil, null to wake it); leave an internal note (note, null to clear); or correct the classifier with `relevant` (true or false: your verdict, which sets relevance to 100 or 0 and moves the mention in or out of the relevant feed; null withdraws it) and `sentiment` (a corrected label; null restores the classifier's). Use the verdicts when the user says a mention is noise or was missed. Omitted fields are untouched. Delivery and billing never change.

inputSchema.description: Every field is optional; omitted fields are untouched.

assigneeId.description: A workspace member (user id), or null to unassign.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. A unique value (a UUID) for this call: 1 to 255 visible ASCII characters, no spaces. Calling again with the same key and the same input within 24 hours returns the first result instead of doing it twice.

note.description: Internal note; null or empty clears it.

relevant.description: Your verdict: true sets relevance to 100 (a filtered mention becomes relevant), false to 0; null restores the classifier's score. Billing never changes. 409 classification_pending while it is still being classified.

sentiment.description: Your corrected sentiment; null withdraws the correction and restores the classifier's.

snoozedUntil.description: ISO 8601 (or epoch ms) until which the mention leaves the feed; null wakes it.

status.description: ignored or done to handle it; open to put it back.

name: update_mention
title: Update mention
